messages:
maria.g: heads-up — auditor_jane asked for an artifact that correlates RBAC changes (k8s rolebinding + IAM) with KMS key usage for Q1. They want a clear chain: who changed role, when, and any KMS decrypts that happened after the change.

sam.s: ok. we can pull K8s audit + terraform change history + CloudTrail KMS events. For k8s: audit logs are in splunk index=infra k8s_audit. For infra-as-code changes: git history + CI job artifacts.

raj.p: timeline? auditor asked Q1 (2024-01-01 -> 2024-03-31) or rolling 90 days?

auditor_jane: Q1 is fine. please include sampling that shows linkage for at least 3 production sign-offs + one rollback scenario. I also need proof of code review and JIRA ticket for the role change.

amelia.k: suggestion: include the PR link, commit hash, and the k8s rolebinding YAML + the API server audit entry showing the user that did the apply. then map to CloudTrail KMS events where that user or a service account performed kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey.

sam.s: quick Splunk query for the k8s audit extract: 
```
index="infra" source="kube-audit" user="*" methodName="patch" OR methodName="create" OR methodName="update" | table _time user objectRef.resource objectRef.name verb requestObject
```
and for KMS CloudTrail: 
```
index="aws_cloudtrail" eventName="Decrypt" OR eventName="GenerateDataKey" resource.type="AWS::KMS::Key" | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters.ciphertextBlob resources
```

maria.g: good. auditor also asked about proof of key material custody — they want the KMS key policy, rotation status, and which KMS key alias maps to which environment. can someone export that?

sam.s: I can export aliases + rotation via AWS CLI: 
```
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 > aliases.json
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id> --region us-west-2
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id> --policy-name default
```
I'll script to run for all keys in account and attach a manifest.

amelia.k: also include the CMK ARN in the evidence manifest so auditor can match resource ARNs in CloudTrail. add a short readme that maps alias -> arn -> environment -> owner.

auditor_jane: chain-of-custody: we need to show that the evidence was exported directly from source systems and not modified. do you have checksums and a signed manifest?

maria.g: evidence-bot can produce a tarball with sha256 sums and upload to secure S3. evidence-bot: can you generate package for Q1 RBAC-KMS correlation? include signed manifest and list of sources (splunk saved searches, git commit SHAs, jira IDs).

evidence-bot: generating package. ETA ~90m. Outputs will be s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/2265432100-q1-rbac-kms-correlation.tar.gz with manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/2265432100-manifest.json and sha256sum appended.

raj.p: one more question — should we include vuln triage timeline from the incident that touched keys last feb? auditor asked to see how incidents influence RBAC changes. if yes, include the vuln triage doc and redacted timeline.

sam.s: yes include the JIRA (RED-1422) with redactions. the triage notes live in Confluence and we can export as PDF. add a short note referencing the incident response runbook we used (incident-runbook-v2).

maria.g: note: redact any user PII in triage doc. security will perform review before packaging.

amelia.k: also include a short control mapping file: map artifacts -> SOC2 CC7.1 / ISO 27001 A.9.2 references and which evidence file satisfies each control. keeps auditor from asking the same Q repeatedly.

auditor_jane: that mapping is helpful. ok to redact personal emails but keep usernames/ARNs. auditors need to validate identity mapping.

sam.s: plan: 1) run Splunk exports for k8s audit + cloudtrail KMS for 2024-01-01..2024-03-31 2) collect git PRs and CI job logs for rolebinding changes 3) pull KMS key policies + rotation status 4) export JIRA + triage PDF (redacted) 5) evidence-bot package and checksum 6) upload links + control mapping doc.

maria.g: i'll own review + redaction pass. sam, please post the s3 links when evidence-bot finishes. i'll then run final integrity check and share with auditor. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: package complete and uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/2265432100-q1-rbac-kms-correlation.tar.gz sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/eng-security/2265432100-manifest.json

maria.g: received. i'll validate checksums and then create a temporary auditor bucket with read-only presigned links. expected share by EOD PST. :eyes:

auditor_jane: thank you — that looks like what we need. i'll review and circle back if anything missing.

maria.g: closing loop — evidence uploaded and shared. will follow up if auditor requests deeper sample (they sometimes request raw event payloads).
